process.lead: A clear process, designed for international buyers too.

1.title: First conversation
1.text: We understand your goal — living, vacationing or investing — and your budget.

2.title: Shortlist & visits
2.text: We present options and schedule in-person or virtual tours.

3.title: Reservation

4.title: Due diligence
4.text: An independent attorney reviews titles, permits and the contract.

5.title: Contract & payments
5.text: You sign the agreement and follow the agreed payment plan.

6.title: Delivery
6.text: You receive your property, the title and, if you wish, rental management.
